Lemma
[Distribution-function identities] 1. ch9:9.7\group chapter-9Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0239 For $p>0$ and $|f|^p\in L^1(\Omega )$, \begin{equation} \mu _f(t)\le t^{-p}\int _\Omega |f|^p. \tag {9.22} \end{equation} \begin{equation} \int _\Omega |f|^p=p\int _0^\infty t^{p-1}\mu _f(t)\, dt. \tag {9.23} \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch The first inequality follows by integrating over $\{ |f|>t\} $. For the second, write $|f(x)|^p=\int _0^{|f(x)|}pt^{p-1}\, dt$ and apply Fubini.

□
